LanguageData.ALConfigAnimalsCanUseFoodDispenserToolti: Animals would be capable of pressing that button. Warning: contains a minor detour (extremely unlikely chance to have a conflict). If animals still don't use the dispenser, check if the building itself is in the allowed area.
LanguageData.CleanPathfinding.Settings.RegionCostCalc: Fixes a nullpointer that causes error spam when calculating a tile's cost, usually due to a bugged map change
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.ManagerSettings.Disab: Removing a manager from this list will make it so that manager's tab and manager settings will be hidden. Jobs will still show up until manually removed, though. You can turn a manager off if you never use a specific manager's features, e.g., to declutter your UI. Changes here will not take effect until the manager tabs window is closed and re-opened or the mod's settings windows is closed and re-opened.
LanguageData.GR_BeginArchotechGrowthCellDesc: Begin creation of an archotech growth cell. This will need all necessary DNA banks to be at 100% progress
LanguageData.GR_StartMechaBlastDesc: Vents exhaust in the tiles surrounding the mechanoid hybrid, burning anything close to it
LanguageData.Kopp_CISE_ShowSelectEveryhing: Show the button 'Select everything' in the caravan forming dialog, regardless of whether the dev mode is active:
LanguageData.MedkitTendSelfDesc: Tend their own wounds on the spot
LanguageData.NL_FA_Enable_Facial_Animation_For_Non_Co: If disabled, it stop to apply non-colonists' animations. It will reduce the load on the facial animation's load.
LanguageData.Outposts.Abandoned.Desc: {0} has been abandoned due to having no one inside to run it. It will very quickly be looted and taken over by nature, leaving no trace it was ever there.
LanguageData.ReadableNumbers_Cache_Desc: Used to improve performance by storing the formatted versions of previously encountered text\nThe cache is cleared whenever it reaches the set capacity, to prevent memory usage or delay looking up previous text
LanguageData.TD.SettingZoneSizeDesc: Growing zones show count of empty / mature plots. The "Fertile" count is the approximate equivalent number of 100% fertility land (e.g 100 plots with 140% fertility would yield about the same as 140 at 100% fertility) (And this takes into account plant fertility sensitivity)
LanguageData.TG.RegroupTooltip: Regroup on Leader's position.\nSquad leader is first pawn in group
LanguageData.TendInBedDesc: Tend their own wounds in the nearest medical bed
LanguageData.VCEF_ChooseFishDesc: Choose preferred fish size to catch from those inhabiting this biome. Smaller fish take less time but are less nutritive, while larger fish take longer and are more nutritive. Medium fish are balanced between the two extremes. There is always a chance to catch some different fish or special items
LanguageData.VFEM2_MerchantCaravanSpawnCount: Merchant caravan spawn count (scalable with world population size)
LanguageData.VF_UpgradeableDesc: Vehicle can be modified through an upgrade tree
LanguageData.VGE_MaintenanceMultiplier: Maintenance loss multiplier (higher is faster maintenance loss)
LanguageData.VPE.MustTargetBattery: Must target a battery or friendly mechanoid
LanguageData.VQEA_CompleteMoreAncientLabQuests: You can complete more ancient lab quests to find and loot more lab equipment. Each piece of the lab provides unique benefits that will improve the odds of a successful injection.
LanguageData.VRE_DisablePhotophobiaMessage_Descriptio: By default, every time a pawn with the photophobia gene flees from light the game will generate a letter informing the player. This may be a bit too much if you have many pawns fleeing often, so you can disable it with this toggle. Bear in mind the pawns will still flee, you'll just NOT get informed.
